summary: Iteration 72 — tested InFlow's own direct Intuit QuickBooks OAuth (replacing Scalekit QBO) + Stripe-only Scalekit + /connect-business UI. 23/23 backend pytest tests PASS (status/start/callback error flows, scalekit no-QBO, business platforms no-QBO, fake-conn status/sync/disconnect, concurrent refresh rotation under single lock). Frontend: scalekit-section shows QuickBooks (direct, sandbox), Stripe (via Scalekit, connected ACTIVE) and Zoho (direct) cards; QBO button labeled 'Connect QuickBooks'; no finalize link; QBO absent from Available Platforms; Stripe paste-key card still present; all three return-param toasts fire (quickbooks=connected&records=4 → 'imported 4 invoices', quickbooks_error → readable msg, zoho=connected&records=2 → 'imported 2 deals'); clicking Connect QuickBooks navigates to accounts.intuit.com SSO redirecting to appcenter.intuit.com/connect/oauth2 with correct client_id, scope, redirect_uri and state. Also updated iter71 Zoho test (connectors=['stripe']) — still passes.

issues: 'all Zoho regions· Two-way sync' lacks a space before the middle-dot — missing a leading space on the Two-way sync span (line 597 of ConnectBusiness.js). Cosmetic only.

action_items: (optional cosmetic) Add a leading space before the '· Two-way sync' label span on the Scalekit cards so it reads 'all Zoho regions · Two-way sync' instead of 'all Zoho regions· Two-way sync'.
critical_code_review_comments: quickbooks_integration.py is clean (~260 lines), uses async, encrypts tokens, excludes mongo _id, per-connection asyncio.Lock with persistence of rotated refresh tokens — correct Intuit behavior.
Callback uses find_one_and_delete on state (one-time use) and short expiry — good replay protection.
On successful auth, old Scalekit QBO connection + its synced deals are purged (keeps testpro's orphaned Scalekit row from colliding). Good.
_token raises PermissionError on invalid_grant and sync endpoint flips row status to REAUTH_REQUIRED — verified end-to-end against fake conn.
seed_data_creation: Fixtures auto-seed a FAKE qbo_oauth conn for testpro and clean up after. Rotation test seeds conn_fake_rotation with monkeypatched _token to prove exactly 1 refresh under concurrent access_token() + new refresh token persisted.
context_for_next_testing_agent: QBO direct OAuth is live. The real happy-path requires an interactive Intuit sandbox login (user-only). The in-process monkeypatch coverage in test_quickbooks_direct_oauth_iter72.py::test_token_rotation_concurrent_refresh proves refresh+rotation+persistence under contention. Scalekit now only offers Stripe (CONNECTORS={'stripe'}); any older iter70 tests asserting Scalekit QBO are obsolete.
